# pbs_notification_matcher (Data Source)

Reads a notification matcher (routing rule) configuration from Proxmox Backup Server. Matchers route notifications to specific endpoints based on severity, field values, or calendar events.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name identifier for the notification matcher.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) A comment describing this matcher.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether this matcher is disabled.
- `invert_match` (Boolean) Whether to invert the match logic (send notification when criteria do NOT match).
- `match_calendar` (List of String) List of calendar event IDs to match.
- `match_field` (List of String) List of field=value pairs to match (e.g., `type=gc`, `hostname=pbs1`).
- `match_severity` (List of String) List of severities to match (info, notice, warning, error).
- `mode` (String) Matching mode: `all` (AND logic) or `any` (OR logic). Default is `all`.
- `origin` (String) The origin of this matcher configuration (user-api, user-file, etc.).
- `targets` (List of String) List of notification endpoint names to send notifications to.
